typed_links.link: The dropped-yod collation failure in 025 (וכרתו for ויכרתו at oshb:1Kgs.5.26) and the refrain misquote in 041 ((ו)אתה תשמע השמים at 8:32/34/36/39/43 vs ושמעת השמים only at 8:45/49) fix the book standard set by the peer's first cross-cutting ruling: quoted or attributed text enters a row only after character-level collation against the witness. Also governs 003, 004, 024, 031, 056, 060, 064, 092.

The falsifier of 077's 'reserved construction' claim — אז יבנה שלמה at oshb:1Kgs.11.7 — lies inside 053's own span: exclusivity claims about grammar bind only after a book-wide search, per the peer's second cross-cutting ruling. Also governs 001, 018, 033, 050, 070, 101.

The setumah undercount (ten, not nine, across 4:7-13 + 4:16-18) and the Amen overcount (once in 1:36, never in 1:37) are the same failure at opposite signs: counts enter rows only from an actual tally, per the peer's third cross-cutting ruling.

085 wrongly offered the absence of parashah marks inside 18:20-40 as cohesion evidence; 041 shows the licit converse — setumot present at petition ends recorded as weak articulation without unit force. Under m8-mesh-r2 mark absence is never evidence, symmetrically.

023 is the model row for the offset zones: every Hebrew cite dual-mapped with '(MT)'. 024's wrong '+14' rule (the WEB 4:29-34 segment maps by WEB-20) and the bare zone refs repaired in 103/105 all resolve to that convention: any oshb cite in MT ch 5 or MT 22:44-54 carries its explicit MT mapping.
The two Tier-0 sweep repairs — 'oshb:1Kgs.22.46 (MT = web:1Kgs.22.45)' and 'oshb:1Kgs.22.52 (MT = web:1Kgs.22.51)' — apply the same disclosure convention at the book's tail.

The Gibeon dream frame (3:4-15) and the second theophany (9:1-9, 'as he had appeared to him at Gibeon') form an explicit inclusio bracketing the temple complex — recorded as a relation, never as license to merge.
The two corvée dossiers (5:13-18 levy; 9:15-23 'this is the account') are a paired administrative frame around the building narrative.

The dogs-lick oracle of 21:19 is discharged by the fulfillment notice at 22:38 — a prophecy-execution pair across the Ahab arc; 105's regnal file additionally continues into 2Kgs 1 across the canonical seam (cross-book note, non-authorizing).
